title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Conditions are improving: base rising and sun returning. Cloudbase is at its highest of the day and still rising. Kula Ag had mostly sun over the last hour. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 2 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Kamehameha Schools, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
